outcome: Prevalence of placenta accreta spectrum disorders
Management strategies for placenta accreta spectrum disorders
cohort: 7312 women giving birth over a four-year period
finding: The incidence of placenta accreta spectrum disorders was high (1.4%) at this tertiary teaching hospital, with all cases occurring in multiparous women with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: All cases of placenta accreta spectrum disorders occurred in multiparous women with a previous cesarean section.
